title: Kamohelo ea Lefatše
intro: Nakong ea liteko tse kholo, motho ea tummeng o ile a fuoa leruo le leholo la lefatše, teko ea teboho le boikokobetso. Leeto la motho enoa le sebetsa e le thuto e tebileng mabapi le tlhaho ea nakoana ea lintho tse bonahalang le liphello tsa boikhohomoso. Senola boitsebiso ba moea ona oo pale ea oona e ngotsoeng mobung o ka tlas'a rona.
clues: Ke phetse har'a batho ba tataisoang ke lenģosa le leholo.
Allah o mphile maruo a maholo hoo linotlolo tsa matlotlo a ka e neng e le moroalo o boima ho batho ba bangata ba matla.

Batho ba heso, ba tsebang leruo la ka, ba ile ba nkeletsa hore ke batle bolulo ba Bophelo bo Tlang ka seo Allah a mphileng sona le hore ke se ke ka lebala karolo ea ka ea lefats'e, le ho etsa botle joalo ka ha Allah a nketselitse botle.
Ka boikhohomoso ke ile ka bolela hore leruo la ka le leholo le fihletsoe feela ka tsebo le boiteko ba ka, ke hana mohau ofe kapa ofe oa Molimo.
Ha ke ne ke kopuoa ho kenya letsoho kapa ho ananela melemo ea Allah, ke ile ka hana ka boikhohomoso, ke lumela hore thepa ea ka ke ea ka feela.
Ka lebaka la boikhohomoso le khatello ea ka e feteletseng, Allah o ile a laela lefats'e hore le bulehe 'me le metsa' na le bolulo ba ka.

outcome.label: Sephetho
options: Ho phela bophelo bo bolelele ba boinehelo
Tšenyo e feletseng ka lebaka la boikhohomoso
outcome.answer: Tšenyo e feletseng ka lebaka la boikhohomoso

arabic: فَخَسَفْنَا بِهِۦ وَبِدَارِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَمَا كَانَ لَهُۥ مِن فِئَةٍۢ يَنصُرُونَهُۥ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنتَصِرِينَ
verse: And We caused the earth to swallow him and his home. And there was for him no company to aid him other than Allāh, nor was he of those who [could] defend themselves. (28:81)
